items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: "He's one of the best men that I ever did know."

ctx.x: Yeah, it take a lot of time. Did you know, Mrs., that Buddy Collette is one of the prominent musicians in Los Angeles? You don't know it, I know it, but I'm going to tell you. And I can show you books that would be able to show you his name.

Now, there's one thing that I wanted Buddy to do. If you get him to go down to church and sing. He's not going to do this. Get him to go down to the church and sing for you, go down there where they have the bunch, and you'd sure be a happy person, because he's a fine musician. That's the only thing I can say about him. He can play and sing and straighten music out that need to be straightened out.
